usage: agentware skill promote [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                               [--reviewed-by REVIEWED_BY]
                               slug

positional arguments:
  slug                  proposal slug to promote

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --reviewed-by REVIEWED_BY
                        handle of the reviewer who performed the required
                        adversarial content-review (mandatory)
